notes: The complementizer 'that' is placed on the infinitive ἐλθεῖν under rule 85; giving it to Ἐγένετο, which licenses the clause, remains defensible.

Both articles (s004, s005) are unrepresented on their own terms: the first as the nominalizing article of the articular infinitive under rules 23 and 61, the second as an article before a name under rule 23.
'through' is kept inside διελθόντα's unit as the realization of the preverb δι-, no preposition standing to answer to it (rule 106).
